VISUAL CONTINUITY BIBLE:

This film belongs to the same continuous cinematic universe.

The digital office is the Mokaid AI Office shown in the reference image:
a premium stylized 3D office environment, slightly isometric but fully volumetric,
dark charcoal architecture, sophisticated violet and electric blue neon floor lighting,
warm amber practical lights, elegant desks, screens, plants, meeting room, coffee area,
lounge area and foosball table.

Keep the exact same architecture, furniture language, lighting palette and spatial identity
throughout every shot.

The AI employees are friendly premium stylized humanoid digital workers.
They are not metallic robots and not cartoon characters.
They look intelligent, approachable, professional and slightly futuristic.
Consistent character design throughout the film.

Cinematic physically plausible camera movement.
Premium global illumination.
Soft volumetric light.
Realistic depth of field.
Subtle motion blur.
High-end commercial cinematography.
No chaotic camera movement.
No sudden geometry changes.
No morphing furniture.
No disappearing characters.
No duplicated characters.
No warped screens.
No text generated inside screens unless specifically requested.

Every shot must feel like the camera is physically travelling through one continuous place.
Smooth acceleration and deceleration.
Elegant ease-in and ease-out camera curves.
No hard cuts unless explicitly requested.

CAMERA MOTION LANGUAGE:
The camera movement must feel designed for interactive website scrollytelling.
Every major movement follows cinematic easing curves:
stillness → gradual acceleration → fluid travel → gradual deceleration → stillness.
No constant-speed robotic camera movement.
Create natural visual resting points where the website can pause the video during scrolling.
Use strong foreground parallax when travelling through the office.
Occasionally pass close to desks, plants, chairs and characters to reinforce depth and immersion.
Movement should feel like a premium interactive experience,
somewhere between an Apple product film, a Pixar environment exploration
and a high-end architectural camera tour.
No shaky camera. No handheld movement. No whip pans. No random zooms. No hard transitions.


REVERSE CAMERA TAKE, one physical uninterrupted shot. Start EXACTLY on supplied foosball frame. The real graphite foosball table has a DARK playing field and red players. Exactly TWO adults: violet-shirt man LEFT and amber-sweater man RIGHT, normal proportions, both heads and four hands visible. They remain planted at the SAME table for the ENTIRE take, quiet tiny wrist gestures only; no walking and no extra players. The table never changes shape, color, scale or location.

Camera starts still for one second, then very slowly moves BACKWARD away from the short end of the table along the EXISTING violet floor aisle. The existing blue glass meeting room remains fixed on right, coffee counter at back-left. Modest arc toward the warm coffee counter, not a spin: around seconds4-7 show a ceramic cup resting under the espresso machine, gentle warm steam, sage-blouse auburn woman remains still at the counter or offscreen, no pouring coffee and no drinking. Do not bring players to the coffee counter. Coffee counter and foosball table occupy fixed separate locations in one compact office.

Then camera continues drifting smoothly to the already open blue-glass meeting-room entrance. End by slowly arriving at the EXACT supplied final image of the graphite meeting table, auburn woman in sage blouse seated and violet-shirt colleague standing. If they are visible in the final frame, show them only as existing people inside the room; do not show any person walking between stations, do not duplicate anyone within a frame. Use framing and foreground occlusion to transition spatial visibility naturally. Keep all architecture firmly fixed, floorplan compact and passage unobstructed. No new rooms or desk rows. Finish perfectly steady. No text, no logos, no notifications. No hard cut, no dissolve, no fading people, no moving furniture, no green football surface. Camera is the ONLY significant movement. SOUND: quiet office ambience, no intelligible speech, no voiceover, no music.

EDITORIAL NOTE FOR VISUAL ACTION: This picture will be reversed later, so avoid directional human actions, no walking, no coffee stream, no celebration, no opening doors. Small reversible hand gestures and ambient steam only. The final normal playback follows meeting to coffee to two stable table players.
